title: List of NBA champions - Wikipedia
snippet: As of 2026, the Eastern champions have a 42–38 advantage in NBA titles over the Western champions. The 1949–50 Minneapolis Lakers, who won the NBA Finals, are counted in the Eastern versus Western champions record as they played that sole season in the Central Division before returning to the Western Division.

title: 2026 NBA Finals - Wikipedia
snippet: The 2026 NBA Finals was the championship series of the National Basketball Association 's (NBA) 2025–26 season and conclusion to the season's playoffs. The best-of-seven series ended when the Eastern Conference champion New York Knicks defeated the Western Conference champion San Antonio Spurs, four games to one.
